visual_base.visual_narrative_log: (1) A young girl with short black hair, dressed in a white sleeveless knitted top and black shorts with white stripes, sits at a wooden desk in a well-lit room. She is holding a wooden pencil and focusing on a drawing of a face on a white sheet of paper. Behind her, a white bookshelf is filled with colorful children's books and a few small toys. A white and brown tabby cat is sitting on a spiral notebook on the desk, looking intently at the girl's hand and pencil. (2) The camera zooms in slightly on the tabby cat. The cat remains perched on the notebook, its gaze fixed on the movement of the pencil. The girl's hand moves rhythmically across the paper. The background shows a yellow spherical plush toy and various stationary items, including colored pencils and a box of wet wipes. (3) The tabby cat leans its head forward, bringing its nose close to the wooden pencil as the girl continues to draw. The girl's facial expression is one of deep concentration. The scene is illuminated by soft, bright indoor lighting that creates a warm atmosphere. (4) The cat suddenly opens its mouth slightly, staring towards the camera with a confused or curious expression. The girl remains oblivious, continuing her drawing. The grey and white bookshelf remains the primary background element, providing a domestic context. (5) A close-up shot focuses on the drawing on the paper, which shows a simple cartoon-like face with a wide smile. The girl's small hand is visible as she adds finer details to the sketch. The wooden texture of the desk and the scattered pencils are clearly visible in the foreground. (6) The girl picks up the paper and turns it toward the tabby cat and the camera, smiling slightly. A second grey tabby cat is now more visible sitting behind the first one. Both cats appear to be observing the girl's finished work. The girl rests her bare feet on the rungs of her wooden chair. (7) The video transitions to a solid pale yellow background. A simple animation appears in the center, showing a small boy and girl. Below the graphic, white text reads 'CUI'S FAMILY LIFE' in a clean, sans-serif font.
